g.text: 5-Stage Pipeline: Stochastic Sensor Degradation ➔ ANPR Consensus ➔ Dual-Objective PPO ➔ ZSPF Failover ➔ Empirical Validation
with zero single point of failure
PPO holds red barriers to stop suspect
Replaces mocked canvas approximations with genuine Eclipse SUMO 1.27+ physics,
TraCI socket polling, and realistic RPi 4B 80°C+ thermal throttling dropout modeling.
Key: Gymnasium Env with 112-dim continuous observations
Solves edge vision failure modes where camera glare or hardware thermal throttling
causes erroneous sightings, requiring ≥2 nodes to agree within a 30s window.
Prevents reward collapse and policy divergence by dynamically decoupling civilian
Max-Pressure throughput optimization from high-priority security overrides.
PPO lightweight [64, 64] MLP for <1.2ms edge inference
Provides formal degradation guarantees across network failures. If Tier 2 fails,
agents transition to P2P MARL; if MQTT fails, agents run localized Max-Pressure.
